item.title: SpaceX Taps SINGULUS for 100GW Space AI Compute Supply Chain
item.description:
SpaceX signed a major supply contract with German equipment maker SINGULUS to bring in complete heterojunction (HJT) solar cell production lines, building in-house power capacity for its Starmind space AI compute satellites. The first line is slated for delivery in H1 2027, with plans to scale to over 100GW of equipment capacity, roughly 4.4 times the Three Gorges Dam's installed capacity.

原文标题：SpaceX 锁定 100GW 太空 AI 算力设备产能

Why it matters：太空 AI 算力首次出现明确的百吉瓦级供电产能规划，标志算力基础设施向轨道延伸。

item.title: Microsoft Auto SR Debuts on Handhelds with 120 FPS Performance Mode
item.description:
Microsoft has officially rolled out its AI upscaling technology Auto SR to the Asus ROG Xbox Ally X handheld and select AMD Ryzen Copilot+ PCs, enabling handheld battery-powered use and 1080p game support for the first time. A new Performance Mode raises the frame-rate cap from roughly 60-75 FPS to 120 FPS and can now run alongside Auto HDR. The rollout is staged and requires updated Xbox Game Bar, Windows 11, and the Auto Super Resolution Package from the Microsoft Store.

原文标题：微软 Auto SR 正式上线掌机 帧率上限提至 120 FPS

Why it matters：微软 AI 超分技术首次落地掌机端并解锁 120 FPS 性能模式，是 Windows 游戏 AI 增强能力的重要一步。

item.title: US Commerce Dept Stalls Blacklisting Megaspeed Over Nvidia Chip Smuggling
item.description:
The US Commerce Department has stalled adding Megaspeed to its export blacklist for two months, despite four agencies—State, Treasury, Energy and the Pentagon—pushing to list the firm over suspected smuggling of Nvidia chips into China, the Financial Times reported. Commerce chairs the panel that approves such listings.

原文标题：美商务部搁置将 Megaspeed 列入出口黑名单

Why it matters：涉及英伟达芯片对华出口管制与美政府内部政策分歧，是算力供应链监管的重要信号。

item.title: AMD Unveils Instinct Coder 355 with Eight MI355X Accelerators
item.description:
AMD and Spectro Cloud launched Instinct Coder 355, an enterprise AI coding platform built on eight Instinct MI355X accelerators plus dual 64-core EPYC 9575F CPUs, running GLM-5.3 locally at 98% of frontier-model performance. Each node serves up to 85 developers (50 concurrent) and defaults to on-prem compute instead of cloud APIs, targeting private enterprise coding workloads.

原文标题：AMD 推出本地 AI 编程平台 搭载 8 张 MI355X

Why it matters：这是 AMD 以整机方案切入企业私有化 AI 编程市场的标志性动作，硬件规格与本地推理性能数据具体可查。

item.title: Alibaba Teases Qwen4 Launch with Preview Model Now Live
item.description:
Alibaba has announced that its next-generation Qwen4 model is coming, emphasizing deeper knowledge understanding, richer world perception, and improved coding and agentic capabilities. A Qwen4-Max preview is already live on Alibaba's Token Plan, with products such as Qwen Office, Qoder, Qwen App and QwenStudio integrating it. No parameter counts, benchmark results or official release date were disclosed, and the announcement leans on discounted trial pricing.

原文标题：阿里 Qwen4 官宣即将发布 预览版已上线

Why it matters：国产头部基座模型代际更新，但当前仅有预告与预览入口，缺乏可验证参数与评测数据。

item.title: ACE Music v1 Debuts Atop Music Arena, Surpassing Suno v6
item.description:
ACE Studio released ACE Music v1, which debuts at #1 on Artificial Analysis' AA-Music-Vocal v1.1 leaderboard, ahead of Suno v6. The model generates full tracks with vocals or instrumentals from text prompts or user lyrics, performing best on Reggae/Dancehall and Classical/Orchestral styles. It has no API and is available only in the ACE Music app, with a free tier of 20 daily credits and paid plans from $7.90 per month.

原文标题：ACE Music v1 登顶音乐竞技场超越 Suno v6

Why it matters：音乐生成赛道出现新榜首，且 ACE Studio 与阶跃星辰共研开源模型 ACE-Step，值得关注其技术路线与产品化节奏。

item.title: Moore Threads Adapts MTT S5000 for MiniMax H3-Image on Day Zero
item.description:
Moore Threads announced that its MTT S5000 AI card and MUSA software stack were adapted for MiniMax H3-Image on the same day the model was open-sourced, enabling single-card generation of 4096×4096 high-resolution images. The adaptation reuses SGLang, MATE and MCCL components and targets the heavy attention overhead of diffusion models under multi-reference inputs, laying groundwork for Day-0 support of future image and video generation models.

原文标题：摩尔线程 MTT S5000 完成 MiniMax H3-Image 首日适配

Why it matters：国产 GPU 对开源生图模型实现首日适配，是观察国产算力生态成熟度的具体信号。

item.title: Chengdu Unveils Fifth-Generation Gongga Humanoid Robot Brain
item.description:
Chengdu Humanoid Robot Innovation Center has unveiled the fifth-generation Gongga humanoid robot, featuring a self-developed embodied intelligence system that claims to close the loop from structured perception to execution feedback. Its highlights include a physical spatiotemporal memory engine and a latent-space action-conditioned world model, though the 'world-leading' claim lacks third-party validation and quantitative benchmarks.

原文标题：成都发布第五代贡嘎人形机器人具身大脑

Why it matters：国产人形机器人具身大脑的系统性迭代值得关注，但宣传口径大于可验证事实，需谨慎看待。

item.title: Anthropic Expands Claude MCP Apps to Embed Third-Party App Interfaces
item.description:
Anthropic expanded Claude's MCP Apps from in-conversation views to full embedded application interfaces, adding App Tools and Embedded Sites so users can operate apps like Adobe, Atlassian, Box, HubSpot and Notion directly inside Claude. It also granted Pro, Max, Ultra and Team users a one-time full usage reset after token over-consumption issues. Built on the open Model Context Protocol, the apps can run in other MCP-compatible AI clients.

原文标题：Claude 扩展 MCP Apps 支持第三方应用内嵌

Why it matters：MCP Apps 从对话视图升级为完整应用嵌入，是智能体与工具生态交互形态的实质演进。

item.title: Simple Few-Shot Prompting Lets Small Open Models Match Complex Methods
item.description:
A paper finds that on natural language inference (NLI), a single short direct prompt with a few in-context examples lets small open models such as Gemma 2 9B, Mistral 7B and Llama 3.1 8B match or beat prior methods that relied on complex prompting and sampling tricks. Mistral 7B surpassed the 63.4% MNLI accuracy reported by a published in-context sampling method, and performance with 1 example was roughly equal to 15 examples.

原文标题：简单少样本提示即可让小模型追平复杂方法

Why it matters：结论反直觉且可直接复用：少样本直给提示即可替代复杂提示工程，对使用小模型做分类任务的开发者有实际参考价值。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · llm · signal 58/100

item.title: Khosla Ventures Co-Leads $25M Round in Coframe for AI-Generated Per-Visitor Web Pages
item.description:
Khosla Ventures co-led a $25M round in Coframe, betting that AI can drive the cost of building web pages low enough to generate a personalized page for every visitor, replacing the static website model. The deal is a direct capital bet on the per-visitor dynamic web paradigm.

原文标题：Khosla 领投 Coframe 2500 万美元 用 AI 为每位访客生成独立网页

Why it matters：知名风投对 AI 个性化网页生成赛道的实质下注，反映网站形态可能的技术路线变化。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · industry · signal 58/100

item.title: Microsoft Ships .NET 11 with Built-in MCP Templates and Agent Framework
item.description:
Microsoft released .NET 11 at .NET Conf 2026 as a Standard Term Support version with two years of support. The release adds hundreds of runtime and base-library performance optimizations and deepens AI tooling: the SDK ships MCP server templates, companion AI libraries and an agent framework cover model access, tool calling and workflow orchestration, and Blazor gains experimental AI UI components. C# 15 introduces union types, and .NET MAUI now defaults to the CoreCLR runtime.

原文标题：微软发布 .NET 11 内置 MCP 模板与智能体框架

Why it matters：主流开发平台正式将 MCP 与智能体能力纳入官方工具链，对 .NET 生态开发者具有直接可用性。

item.title: Moonshot AI Brings Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed to Amazon Bedrock
item.description:
Moonshot AI has released the Kimi K3.1 series, with Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed now available on Amazon Bedrock. Built on the same 3T-class open-weight architecture and 1-million-token context window as Kimi K3, it was post-trained with substantially more compute to target long-horizon agentic work, reduce factual errors, and improve professional tasks such as financial modeling, office documents, and coding for game engines, 3D scenes, and CAD scripts. The Highspeed variant delivers 2-3x the output speed of K3.1 Pro and reuses the same endpoints and APIs, so developers can switch by changing the model ID.

原文标题：月之暗面 Kimi K3.1 Pro 高速版上架 Amazon Bedrock

Why it matters：3T 级开源权重模型叠加百万上下文与 2-3 倍推理提速，并通过 Bedrock 一键切换，对关注开源大模型落地与智能体长程任务的读者具备直接参考价值。

item.title: Anthropic Lifts IPO Target Valuation to $1.5 Trillion on Strong Demand
item.description:
Anthropic's bankers plan to raise the IPO price range after heavy investor demand, lifting the target valuation back above $1.5 trillion. The Tuesday filing set a $70-$78 share range implying $1.26T-$1.41T including options and restricted shares; pricing above that range would push proceeds past $100B, with Google, Nvidia and Microsoft investing $26B at the IPO price. Three backers say Anthropic now prioritizes raising cash over maximizing valuation, given roughly $900B of planned compute and infrastructure spending.

原文标题：Anthropic 上调 IPO 目标估值至 1.5 万亿美元

Why it matters：万亿美元级 IPO 定价与 9000 亿美元算力支出计划，是 AI 产业资本格局的标志性事件。

item.title: Google Adds Kimi and DeepSeek Models to Android Bench Leaderboard
item.description:
Google has published the first Android Bench results for Kimi K3.1 Pro and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, with Kimi reaching a 24.0% pass rate above Claude and Gemini entries while DeepSeek delivers strong cost efficiency at $9.9 per run. The benchmark targets real Android engineering tasks, giving developers a quantified reference for long-horizon agent capability.

原文标题：谷歌 Android Bench 新增 Kimi 与 DeepSeek 评测

Why it matters：第三方权威基准首次纳入国产模型并公开成本与耗时数据，对开发者模型选型有直接参考价值。

item.title: CoreWeave Q3 Revenue Jumps 168% as Net Loss Widens to $709M
item.description:
CoreWeave's third-quarter revenue surged 168% year over year to $3.66B, but net loss widened more than sixfold to $709M, driven by net interest expense climbing to $846M from $310M, exceeding the quarter's $379M adjusted operating income. The company borrows to pre-buy Nvidia GPUs ahead of rental income, burning $7.5B after capital spending, and ended the quarter with about $4.12B cash against nearly $47B debt, making further growth dependent on new borrowing or share sales. Contracted backlog rose to $132.5B and the 2026 revenue forecast was lifted to $13B-$13.3B.

原文标题：CoreWeave 三季度营收 36.6 亿美元净亏损 7.09 亿

Why it matters：AI 算力租赁龙头的营收高增长与债务驱动扩张模式形成鲜明对照，是观察算力基建资本结构风险的关键样本。

item.title: Huawei Maextro V8 MPV Set for November 20 Launch with Qiankun ADAS
item.description:
Huawei has scheduled a November 20, 2026 event for the Maextro V8 and its new Xingmang brand. The V8, Maextro's first MPV, starts at 329,800 yuan and ships standard with an 800V platform, ±12° rear-wheel steering and Huawei's Qiankun ADAS; Ultra trims add four lidars and an L3-capable architecture.

原文标题：华为享界 V8 定档 11 月 20 日 全系标配乾崑智驾

Why it matters：华为智驾方案落地新车型，L3 架构与四激光雷达配置对关注自动驾驶落地的读者有参考价值。

item.title: Sixteen LLMs Play TIS-100 and Set 133 New Frontier Points
item.description:
Wincon Research had 16 frontier and open-weight LLMs attempt all 47 TIS-100 assembly puzzles with the community leaderboard withheld; the models produced 133 new frontier points, new records on 18 puzzles, and 3 outright cycle records. Human players then picked up and improved most of the generated programs within days, showing the outputs were genuinely usable engineering artifacts.

原文标题：16 款大模型挑战 TIS-100 编程游戏刷新 133 项纪录

Why it matters：以经典汇编解谜游戏为基准，量化大模型在受限指令集与多目标权衡下的程序合成能力，并有人类接力验证。

item.title: Anthropic Adds Whiteboards and Sheets to Claude Artifacts
item.description:
Anthropic added Whiteboards and Sheets as new collaborative Artifact formats in Claude, available to all paid plans including Pro, with staged rollout underway; the October Dashboards feature also exited beta as Claude Data. The author frames this as evidence that software's primary user is shifting from humans to agents, with humans reviewing and fine-tuning.

原文标题：Claude 新增白板与表格并上线 Claude Data

Why it matters：Claude Artifacts 扩展协作格式并覆盖全部付费套餐，同时提供了一个关于软件形态演进的观察视角。

item.title: KORA Systems Unveils AI-Native KORA OS to Challenge Windows 11
item.description:
KORA Systems has unveiled KORA OS, billed as the first operating system built from the ground up for AI PCs, embedding agentic workflows, contextual memory and local inference at the system level rather than bolting an AI assistant onto a conventional OS. Built on NixOS, it uses a proprietary Cortex inference engine to orchestrate CPU, GPU and NPU resources, debuting on Qualcomm's Snapdragon X2 Elite before expanding to AMD and Intel x86 platforms.

原文标题：KORA OS 发布 首个原生 AI PC 操作系统挑战 Win11

Why it matters：这是 AI PC 从应用层走向操作系统层的标志性尝试，涉及本地推理调度与芯片适配，值得关注其后续落地。

item.title: Apple Subsidiary Claris Tests Harbor to Turn Macs into Local AI Servers
item.description:
Claris, a wholly owned Apple subsidiary, is testing Harbor, an app that turns Apple-silicon Macs into local AI inference servers and can link multiple Macs over Thunderbolt 5 to run larger models. The app emphasizes zero-configuration setup, auto-detecting Thunderbolt 5 devices and letting users browse and download open-weight models, backed by Thunderbolt 5 RDMA support shipped in macOS Tahoe 26.2. Harbor remains in early access and is not yet publicly available.

原文标题：苹果子公司 Claris 测试 Harbor 让 Mac 变身本地 AI 服务器

Why it matters：苹果生态首次出现官方背景的本地 AI 集群方案，对端侧推理与私有部署走向有信号意义。

item.title: Anthropic Launches $64.35B IPO and Unveils Claude Fable 5.2
item.description:
Anthropic is pursuing two major moves at once: launching an IPO roadshow to raise up to $64.35 billion at a $1T-$1.4T valuation with Google and Nvidia participating, and releasing Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, which it claims surpass GPT-6 Astra in coding with 30% faster output and 20% lower cost. Google also opened its strongest reasoning model Gemini 4 Carbon the same day, intensifying frontier model competition.

Why it matters：Anthropic 巨额 IPO 与新一代旗舰模型同日落地，是 AI 产业资本与模型能力双重节点。

item.title: 研究显示生成式 AI 正成为新闻信息中介
item.description:
路透新闻研究所对九国受众的调查显示，生成式 AI 系统正从独立工具演变为重要的信息中介，无论用户主动使用还是被动接触。但受众对 AI 参与新闻生产仍持保留态度，这一落差对媒体与 AI 平台的合作策略构成直接约束。

Why it matters：基于九国受众调查的实证研究，量化了 AI 作为信息入口的渗透程度与公众接受度落差。

item.title: 论文指出递归自我改进安全评估仍无框架
item.description:
一篇论文指出，递归自我改进（RSI）正被多家 AI 公司推进，但业界既无共识判断其何时安全，也缺乏思考其长期走向的基本框架。作者还以普通用户身份演示，仅用一条高层提示就让 AI 从零训练出一个小型 LLM，说明能力门槛正在快速降低。

Why it matters：聚焦递归自我改进的安全评估缺口，并给出低门槛复现实验，对关注 AI 安全与能力演进的读者有参考价值。

item.title: 微软游说美政府放弃中国光模块进口限制
item.description:
微软联合多家科技企业与行业组织游说美国政府，反对将中国新型号光收发器纳入进口限制，理由是可能造成关键零部件短缺并拖慢 AI 数据中心建设。中国厂商约占全球光收发器市场三分之二，而美国本土产能短期内难以替代。FCC 正考虑限制 3.2Tbps 速率产品，最终规则尚未公布。

Why it matters：光模块是 AI 数据中心互联的关键瓶颈，禁令走向直接影响算力扩张节奏与供应链格局。

item.title: Anthropic 七位联合创始人 IPO 各套现约 2.5 亿美元
item.description:
Anthropic 更新招股书，七位联合创始人将在 IPO 中各出售 337.84 万股，按 74 美元发行价中值计算每人套现约 2.5 亿美元，合计约 17.5 亿美元。公司拟发行 8.25 亿股 A 类股票并在纳斯达克上市，代码 ANT，最高估值或达 1.4 万亿美元；创始人通过 Founder LLC 与 F 类特殊股保留 50.1% 投票权，控制权不变。

Why it matters：万亿级估值 IPO 与创始人巨额套现细节，是 AI 头部公司资本化路径的关键节点。

item.title: FishAudio 发布 Live 3 全双工语音模型
item.description:
FishAudio 推出 Live 3 全双工语音模型，支持边听边说、自然插入“mm-hmm”等反馈并在合适时机停止发言，用户仅需一句话即可生成可用的语音智能体。官方同步开放企业定制智能体预约，并为前 1000 名提交用例者免费构建。

Why it matters：全双工语音交互是语音智能体的关键能力跃迁，且一句话生成可用智能体具备直接可试性。

item.title: LiteDRAM 开源可配置 DRAM 核心解析
item.description:
LiteDRAM 是 LiteX 生态中基于 Migen 实现的小体积可配置 DRAM 控制器核心，提供厂商无关的通用 SDR PHY，支持 1:1 或 1:2 频率比，并已在 Xilinx、Altera、Lattice 平台验证。项目强调 DDR3 及以上接口需在启动阶段完成 PHY 时序调校，可作为 LiteX 库使用或生成 Verilog RTL 集成到标准设计流程。

Why it matters：面向 FPGA 开发者的开源 DRAM 控制器项目文档，具备明确的技术参考价值。

item.title: AWS 推出 AgentCore 网页搜索 API 支持域过滤
item.description:
Amazon Bedrock AgentCore 正式上线 Web Search API，智能体可通过单次调用获取带标题、URL、发布日期与摘要的实时网页结果，查询全程在 AWS 自有索引内完成，不经过第三方搜索引擎。该 API 支持按域名包含或排除、按发布日期区间过滤，并可与 LangGraph 组合构建每日依赖变更监控等生产级工作流。

Why it matters：云厂商把可引用的实时搜索能力内建进智能体运行时，对构建生产级检索工作流的团队有直接参考价值。

AWS Machine Learning Blog · tools · signal 58/100

item.title: Meta FAIR 开源 e-means 聚类提速 45 倍
item.description:
Meta FAIR 开源了 k-means 的即插即用替代方案 e-means，通过小批量读取与指数移动平均维护簇统计量，并用两条拟合缩放律自动确定批大小与步长，无需额外调参。官方数据显示其仅需 1.4 至 2.6 个 epoch 即可达到 Lloyd 算法 25 个 epoch 的损失水平，GPU 上相对 Flash-KMeans 提速 10 至 45 倍，并成功将 100 亿条 DINO 嵌入聚为 1670 万个簇。代价是结果具有随机性，且大规模质心需分片存储。

Why it matters：经典聚类算法获得数量级加速且已开源，对大规模嵌入聚类与数据管线有直接实用价值。

Marktechpost (@Marktechpost) · opensource · signal 78/100
